implemented: A detached deterministic one-mile POI footprint adapter with stable identity and immutable output.

Unknown-size ordinary sites and Mythic Bastionland Seats select one cell; unknown-size true capitals require at least two edge-connected cells; measured polygons are authoritative and may select one or many cells.
A required water attachment retains the selected live water kind, water ID and segment ID and must contact a selected cell; validation never moves or regenerates source hydrography.
An assigned road or trail is accepted only when a real segment has positive length strictly inside the footprint; adjacency and edge/corner-only contact fail.
Unassigned routes are not forced onto POIs, and invalid candidates fail atomically without mutating source POI, water or route data.

test_change_summary.scenario_risk: B/C protects extent policy, one-identity multi-cell footprint, exact water reference and positive-length assigned route contact.
test_change_summary.reuse_or_new_reason: Existing A1/A2 cases cover grid/projection/state but cannot exercise placement legality. The strict state fixture was extended for typed water/route kinds; two new logical cases cover distinct extent and access invariants.
test_change_summary.count_source: Named logical Node test registrations; the existing DETAIL1 state case is counted as modified, not deleted and re-added.

limitations: The B/C adapter remains disconnected from App generation, the active document, history/Undo, import/export and UI.
No whole DETAIL1 acceptance, independent review or product-score transition is claimed.
